1. This Order may be cited as the Airport Service Charge
(Exemption) Order, 1994.
2. Persons travelling from the Airport by chartered aircraft on
sight-seeing tours to a place outside Barbados, for a period not
exceeding one day, are exempt from the payment of airport service
charge in respect of that journey.
